title: Linux Setup & Ricing

shortDescription: Fully reproducible Linux environment managed with Ansible and GNU Stow — i3, Neovim, Polybar, EWW widgets, and automated recovery
details:
An ongoing project to make my entire Linux setup fully reproducible and recoverable from scratch. Managed via Ansible for provisioning and GNU Stow for dotfile symlinks, with a bootstrap script that gets everything running from a single command.

The desktop environment is built around i3 window manager with a custom Polybar status bar and EWW-powered widgets. Editor setup centres on Neovim with a full LSP configuration. The shell is Zsh with a tuned config, and a startup script handles automatic workspace layout on login.

The goal is that if I boot a fresh Arch install, I should be back to a fully working, familiar environment in minutes — not hours of manual configuration.
